summary: Segment 1 of 8 of a raw screen recording of the Maude photo editor. It opens on an idle canvas (skippable dead air + an accidental app-switcher flash), then the user drags an athlete portrait onto the canvas and the Photo inspector panel opens — the clearest shot here for the brief's 'AI background removal' beat, showing the adjustment sliders and a 'Remove Background' button, though it is never clicked. The user then switches to the Assistant chat panel and spends the rest of the clip (~49s) slowly typing a prompt asking Claude to build an IG post, remove the background, and use the 'mvp' template with player details — no removal, template application, or finished result is actually shown completing; that presumably lands in a later segment. Overall this clip is mostly setup/typing rather than the fast, visual before/after payoff the brief wants.
